Responsável por conduzir o pós‑venda após a assinatura do contrato de compra e venda: emissão de guias ITBI, relacionamento com tabelionatos e Registro de Imóveis, minutas e procurações, registro de escrituras, acompanhamento de financiamento/consórcio (crédito, engenharia, assinatura no banco) até a efetiva transferência da propriedade. Presencial, PJ (MEI), horário comercial. Remuneração: fixo + variável por GPV concluído.

Descrição completa


Sobre a 636

A 636 Negócios Imobiliários é referência em atendimento consultivo e processos robustos de venda. Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Pós‑Venda Imobiliário para atuar 100% presencial em Joinville/SC, garantindo uma jornada segura e ágil do cliente após a assinatura do contrato de compra e venda.


Sua missão

Ser o elo entre cliente, cartórios, Registro de Imóveis, correspondentes bancários e bancos para concluir a transferência de propriedade, cumprindo prazos, requisitos legais e as promessas jurídicas firmadas no contrato.


O que você fará (principais responsabilidades)

  • Emitir e conferir guias de ITBI (Imposto de Transmissão) e FRJ (Fundo de Reaparelhamento do Judiciário – quando aplicável).
  • Relacionar‑se com tabelionatos e Registro de Imóveis: protocolos, exigências, retorno e registro de escrituras.
  • Preparar/checar minutas de escritura e procurações;
    organizar documentação das partes.
  • Acompanhar o cliente presencialmente no tabelionato e no banco quando necessário.
  • Acompanhar financiamento habitacional ou consórcio: análise documental, aprovação de crédito (com correspondentes ou agências), vistoria de engenharia e assinatura do contrato.
  • Gerir o GPV (Gestão de Processos de Venda) de cada contrato, atualizando status, prazos e pendências até a finalização.
  • Manter comunicação clara com clientes, corretores e áreas internas;
    zelar pelo cumprimento das obrigações contratuais entre as partes.


Como medimos seu resultado (GPV)

  • GPVs concluídos por quinzena (cada contrato = 1 GPV).
  • SLA de etapas (ex.: prazos para escritura, registro, liberação do financiamento).
  • Qualidade: baixa taxa de exigências/pendências e satisfação do cliente após a escritura.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência prática em pós‑venda imobiliário, cartórios/Registro de Imóveis ou financiamento imobiliário.
  • Leitura e conferência de documentação imobiliária (escritura, matrícula, certidões, procuração).
  • Vivência com bancos/correspondentes (crédito, engenharia, assinatura).
  • Organização e gestão de prazos, atenção a detalhes, comunicação clara.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho 100% presencial em Joinville/SC, horário comercial.
  • PJ (MEI) ativo ou disponibilidade para abertura.


Diferenciais (bons de ter)

  • Ter atuado com consórcios (imobiliário) e/ou crédito habitacional.
  • Noções de Direito Imobiliário e tributos (ITBI/FRJ/Emolumentos).
  • Vivência com CRM/gestão de processos;
    domínio de Pacote Office ou Google Workspace.
  • CNH B e mobilidade para deslocamentos locais (cartórios/bancos).


Modelo de contratação e remuneração

  • PJ (MEI), presencial, horário comercial.
  • Remuneração mista: fixo mensal + variável por GPV finalizado na quinzena.
  • Não há benefícios adicionais.


Local

  • Matriz 636 – Joinville/SC (atuação presencial com saídas pontuais a cartórios e bancos).

Se você gosta de processos bem feitos, tem ritmo, organização e curte resolver vidas no cartório e no banco, envie sua candidatura.

title: Profissional Programador Java(Sr)
description:
BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!



  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


  • O que você deve ter?

Requisitos técnicos:

  • Java (8+), Spring Boot, REST APIs, MVC, DDD / Clean Architecture
  • Maven, JUnit / Mockito, GIT (GitFlow, GitLab)
  • Docker, AWS (EC2, ECS, S3, RDS, CloudWatch)
  • Graduação em Computação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir soluções escaláveis e seguras
  • Garantir qualidade de código e boas práticas de arquitetura
  • Integrar sistemas internos e externos (REST, mensageria, eventos)
  • Colaborar com times de produto, arquitetura e front-end

Diferenciais:

  • Kafka, RabbitMQ, Event Hub
  • NoSQL (DynamoDB, MongoDB, Redis)
  • Observabilidade (Grafana, Prometheus, ELK)
  • Arquiteturas event-driven e serverless
  • CI/CD e autenticação (OAuth2, JWT)

Projeto: área de Canais , com foco na migração de funcionalidades do IBPF para IBPJ .

HOMEFLEX (3x por semana presencial)



O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas:

- Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

title: Coordenador(A) De Manutenção – Produção
description:
Essa posição tem papel fundamental em manter os ativos produtivos dentro dos padrões das Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF/GMP), liderando equipes técnicas e promovendo a melhoria contínua dos processos industriais.


⚙️ Responsabilidades Principais

  • Coordenar a execução dos planos de manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva, garantindo a disponibilidade dos equipamentos e o cumprimento das metas de produção;
  • Gerir os ferramentais e formatos utilizados nos setups, assegurando rastreabilidade, conservação e padrões de limpeza;
  • Liderar equipesde manutenção (supervisores e técnicos), promovendo engajamento, desenvolvimento e segurança;
  • Assegurar conformidade com BPF/GMP, POPs e requisitos de Qualidade durante as intervenções;
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas (ANVISA, clientes, certificadoras);
  • Implementar ferramentas de confiabilidade (RCA, FMEA, RCM), buscando aumento de MTBF e redução de MTTR;
  • Acompanhar indicadores de performance, custos e OEE, propondo ações de melhoria e otimização de recursos;
  • Coordenar paradas programadas e apoiar o Almoxarifado Técnico na gestão de sobressalentes;
  • Promover cultura de segurança e conformidade com as NRs aplicáveis (NR-10, NR-12, bloqueio e etiquetagem, etc.);
  • Incentivar práticas Lean, TPM e SMED, fortalecendo a cultura de melhoria contínua.

Indicadores-Chave (KPIs)

  • Disponibilidade e confiabilidade de equipamentos (MTBF / MTTR);
  • Cumprimento do plano preventivo/preditivo;
  • Índice de corretivas vs. preventivas;
  • OEE (suporte à Produção);
  • Custo de manutenção vs. orçamento;
  • Conformidade GMP e indicadores de segurança.

Requisitos

  • Formação: Engenharia Mecânica, Elétrica, Mecatrônica, Produção ou áreas correlatas;
    desejável CREA ativo;
  • Conhecimentos: SAP PM, técnicas de confiabilidade (RCA, FMEA, RCM), TPM/Lean, normas de segurança (NR-10, NR-12), noções de HVAC e utilidades;
  • Competências comportamentais: liderança servidora, visão sistêmica, comunicação clara, tomada de decisão sob pressão, foco em segurança e resultados.


Aqui na Apsen, você vai encontrar:

  • Um ambiente que valoriza o respeito, o desenvolvimento e a inovação ;
  • Lideranças próximas , que acreditam em colaboração e crescimento conjunto;

Fortes habilidades de negociação e comunicação. Capacidade de análise e resolução de problemas. Orientação para resultados e trabalho em equipe.

title: Head Of Brazil Financial Shared Service Center - Midea Group
description:
Company Overview

Midea Group, a globally renowned Fortune 500 enterprise, is a leader in the home appliance and consumer electronics industry with a strong presence across over 200 countries and regions. We are now seeking a high-caliber professional to lead our Brazil Financial Shared Service Center (FSSC), driving operational excellence and supporting the group’s strategic development in the Brazilian market.


Job Location

R. Sen. Milton Campos, 145 - 3º Andar - Vila da Serra, Nova Lima - MG, , Brasil


Job Responsibilities

  1. Oversee the daily operation and management of Brazil FSSC, ensuring compliance with internal policies, local regulations, and global financial standards.
  2. Coordinate closely with FSSC-serviced business units (BUs) in Brazil to align service priorities, resolve operational issues, and guarantee the efficiency and quality of FSSC services .
  3. Establish effective communication and collaboration mechanisms with each FSSC module at Midea Group Headquarters (HQ), ensuring seamless integration of global financial processes and local operational needs.
  4. Lead the building, development, and performance management of the Brazil FSSC team, including talent recruitment, training, goal setting, and performance evaluation, to enhance team capability and engagement.
  5. Serve as the key coordinator for internal and external audits (e.G., statutory audits, internal financial audits), organize audit preparations, provide required materials, and follow up on audit findings to complete audit projects smoothly.
  6. Implement key financial initiatives and projects as assigned by HQ (e.G., system optimization, process reengineering), ensuring on-time delivery and alignment with the group’s financial strategy.


Requirements & Qualifications

  1. Bachelor’s degree or above in Accounting, Finance, or related fields , with solid professional knowledge of accounting standards (e.G., IFRS, Brazilian local accounting standards) and financial operations.
  2. Fluent English (both written and spoken) as the working language;
    proficiency in Mandarin Chinese is mandatory (for communication with HQ);
    knowledge of Portuguese is highly preferred.
  3. Deep understanding of Brazilian business culture, local tax regulations, and financial compliance requirements ;
    prior experience in theBrazilian market is a plus.
  4. Strong leadership and team management skills , with a proven track record of leading and motivating cross-functional teams. Excellent relationship-building abilities to collaborate with internal stakeholders (HQ, local BUs) and external parties (auditors, regulators).
  5. Self-driven, results-oriented, and capable of strategic planning, organizational coordination, and working under pressure to meet tight deadlines.
  6. Prior team leadership experience (preferably in financial shared services, accounting, or finance departments) is highly preferred.


What We Offer

  • The opportunity to work with a Fortune 500 company and contribute to its global financial strategy.
  • A competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits.
  • Clear career development paths and access to global training resources.
  • A dynamic, inclusive, and collaborative work environment.

If you meet the above requirements and are eager to take on this challenging role, please submit your resume and cover letter via LinkedIn. We look forward to welcoming you to Midea’s global team!

title: Staff Frontend Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.

We are feeding the world’s curiosity!

Job Description

The Opportunity

Cint is looking to raise the bar on engineering standards as well as user experiences. We offer a smaller company atmosphere, where engineers can shape technical strategy, lead cross-team initiatives, and set the direction for how we build and deliver products at scale. Our products are redefining experiences within the industry—join us to help define the future of our platform while multiplying the impact of the teams around you.


We’re seeking a Staff Frontend Engineer to join our UI Engineering team. This team is focused on providing frontend solutions to multiple projects and tooling to the whole company. We are deeply committed to advancing our frontend architecture (Next.Js), ensuring alignment with our Design Systems, and collaborating with backend teams to deliver consistent, reliable, and user-friendly experiences across the platform.

What You Will Do

As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you will join our globally distributed team to shape and elevate Cint’s Measurement, Survey Platform, and Design System experiences. Your mission is to craft high-quality, scalable user interfaces that power our core research products delivering intuitive experiences for our customers while also enabling internal teams to move faster with confidence.

You will be a product-oriented and platform UI engineer, taking full ownership of the end-to-user experience. This includes partnering closely with UX designers, product managers, and fellow engineers to understand customer and stakeholder needs for both external user-facing products and internal products like our survey platform and design systems.

Responsabilities:

  • Partner closely with Product Managers and UX designers to deliver polished, user-centric experiences and support product rollouts.

  • Create scalable and maintainable frontend components, while enhancing and extending our shared Design System.

  • Monitor and optimize application performance, resolving bottlenecks proactively.

  • Lead cross-team technical initiatives, set architectural direction, and ensure alignment on frontend strategy across the organization.

  • Proactively shape engineering practices, propose improvements, and influence standards adopted by multiple teams.

  • Advocate for and document best practices in frontend development.

  • Own and architect systems or product areas end-to-end, designing solutions that scale across multiple teams and business domains.

  • Build strong cross-functional relationships to ensure smooth collaboration and alignment.

  • Write clean, modular, and maintainable code that stands the test of time.

  • Continuously improve and refactor existing codebases for reliability and efficiency.

  • Take responsibility for production systems through on-call rotations, ensuring stability and fast incident resolution.

  • Mentor and sponsor engineers at all levels, building future technical leaders and spreading best practices throughout the company.

  • Anticipate organizational and architectural challenges, define long-term strategies, and drive adoption of solutions that improve scalability, reliability, and developer experience across Cint.

Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time driving cross-team technical initiatives and architectural decisions.

  • Highly proficient in Next.Js 14+ (App Router), including expertise in data caching strategies and performance optimization.

  • Demonstrates proficiency in various UI rendering architectures (SSR, CSR, SSG, ISR) and the ability to determine their appropriate application.

  • A proven expertise in designing and implementing robust UI solutions using TypeScript, with a strong focus on applying comprehensive typing throughout the stack to deliver maintainable and highly reliable user experiences.

  • Proficiency in breaking down product documents and abstracts into well-defined feature epics and user stories, driving features from concept to reality promptly.

  • Experience with CSS and Tailwind, and in working with Figma and internal design systems.

  • Track record of building reliable, performant systems and establishing testing and quality practices adopted across teams.

  • Demonstrates strong communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to define and drive technical standards across multiple teams or product lines, aligning stakeholders and ensuring adoption.

  • Experience balancing trade-offs between technical debt, speed, and long-term scalability in a way that advances organizational goals.

Additional Information

Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • We’re accountable for our work and actions
  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • We learn from each other’s experiences
  • Stop and listen;
    every opinion matters
  • We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.


More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. ( />

7. Apoiar no desenvolvimento da equipe, por meio de planejamento e acompanhamento do Planejamento de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI), a fim de conduzir o crescimento dentro da organização;


8. Assegurar retorno a operacionalidade das embarcações em situações de downtime, através de coordenação das necessidades da embarcação e negociação com cliente com o objetivo de reverter o downtime com a menor perda possível de faturamento, assim como a execução e envio de relatórios técnicos ao cliente;

title: Finance Project Analyst
description:
Netcracker Shaping the Digital Future

As a proud subsidiary of NEC Corporation, Netcracker is a global software leader driving innovation at scale. We combine an open Agentic AI Platform with AI-Native IT Solutions to help telecommunication providers transform, innovate, and deliver results that matter. Powered by cutting-edge technology—and the passion of our people—we unlock new opportunities, spark innovation, and create better digital experiences for millions worldwide. Join us and be part of a team that is not just keeping up with the digital future—we’re leading it.


About the role

The Finance Project Analyst will oversee financial performance for assigned projects, focusing on key metrics like budget consumption, invoicing, and cash flow. The role also involves managing vendor contracts, ensuring operational compliance, and escalating financial concerns. Additionally, the analyst will optimize processes, track project health, and assist with forecast, invoicing and payments.


Role & Responsibilities

  • Act as a key contact for interpreting and investigating financial results for assigned projects
  • Prepare, reconcile, analyze, and report project KPIs
  • Review actual and planned resources, flag discrepancies to Project Managers
  • Handle project closeout reconciliations and escalate issues as needed
  • Analyze financial and business data for assigned projects and contracts
  • Coordinate with Project Managers on change orders, project status, resourcing, and budgets
  • Assist in developing regular financial status reports for projects
  • Record monthly revenue for contracts and communicate estimates to clients
  • Monitor subcontractor and vendor contracts, acting as the contact point for external/internal resources
  • Attend project meetings to support Project Managers and ensure accurate forecasting
  • Track overall project health, including revenues, gross profit, receivables, and project closeouts
  • Ensure that operational procedures are being followed by Project Teams
  • Identify and work with team leads to resolve and/or escalate violations as needed
  • Validate reports obtained from projects and ensure that the reports are provided on time
  • Work with project team leads and program directors on operational support needs, set up and lead project meetings
  • Assist with Resource plan baselines
  • Review and manage exceptions and escalate to stakeholders as needed
  • Process and distribute reports, defining tool requirements
  • Analyze and monitor dashboard reports on every project created monthly
  • Identify planned projects monthly
  • Identify projects with Level of Effort (LOE) overage and escalate these to senior management
  • Schedule invoices and assist in their payment
  • Work with management to optimize processes


Required Experience

  • 4 or more years experience working in financial analysis
  • Self-motivated with a strong work ethic and the ability to work independently
  • Able to work well with others
  • Able to use discretion while dealing with confidential matters
  • Able to pay close attention to detail
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Knowledge of Project Management Standard and Great Plains system.
  • Prior experience in project analysis and ASC 606 revenue recognition strongly preferred
  • Prior experience in portfolio financial management and forecasting strongly preferred
  • Significant past experience in an administrative position with responsibility for audit and processing tasks
  • Ability to follow business rules and procedures while analyzing and identifying errors in processes and data
  • Really good attention to detail
  • Fluent English speaker
  • Availability to work from office in hybrid mode


Education

  • BSC in Accounting/Finance, or related field

title: Qa & Ra Specialist
description:
Work place: Sao Paulo, Brazil

QA & RA Specialist (100 % workload)


About Selectchemie AG

Selectchemie is an independent Swiss company serving the pharmaceutical and nutrition industry since 1969 as a premier supplier of high quality ingredients and generic finished dosage forms. As a full service provider we create added value by offering comprehensive technical, scientific, regulatory and commercial support all along the value chain. Worldwide, our 120 experienced professionals with commercial and scientific background, based at the headquarters in Zurich, Switzerland and locations in 18 countries, provide customers, principals and suppliers with solutions tailored to their needs.


Join our Pharma LATAM team

We offer a broad product portfolio of APIs & excipients and are an established hub for customers sourcing high-quality bulk raw material as well as for renowned manufacturers who benefit from our broad customer base in various markets. We are continuously expanding our global network as well as our services. We are seeking a QA & RA Associate to support our Pharma LATAM sales team in achieving their regulatory and quality assurance objectives, with focus on Brazilian and Mexican markets. This role involves close collaboration with internal teams, suppliers, and customers to ensure compliance with ANVISA and other relevant regulations. The ideal candidate will have a strong regulatory mindset, attention to detail, and excellent communication skills.


Your tasks and responsibilities


ANVISA Submissions & API/Excipients Registration

  • Prepare, submit, and manage ANVISA dossiers from our partners and of our ownership for API and excipient registrations, renewals, variations, and amendments, in accordance with RDC 359/2022 and RDC 361/2022, which require registration of APIs used in distribution and manufacturing in Brazil.
  • Ensure compliance with ANVISA regulatory guidelines, monitor updates to regulatory frameworks, and implement required modifications proactively.
  • Be designated as an authorized user in order to act on behalf of the suppliers for CADIFA application.


Life Cycle Management (LCM)

  • Carry out lifecycle maintenance activities, including annual renewals, post-approval changes, and variations for APIs registrations – CADIFA under established procedures
  • Conduct gap analysis for regulatory documents and gather necessary supporting documentation from suppliers and internal stakeholders.


Regulatory Intelligence & Compliance

  • Monitor evolving Brazilian regulatory requirements and advise stakeholders accordingly.
  • Support internal teams—such as Quality, Supply Chain, Legal, and Commercial—by providing up-to-date regulatory guidance for API/excipient registration, import, storage, and distribution compliance.


Client & Stakeholder Support

  • Provide regulatory support and guidance to internal clients (e.G., sales, procurement) and external clients (e.G., manufacturers or exporters of APIs/excipients) regarding registration strategy, timelines, and documentation requirements.
  • Assist during ANVISA inspections, inquiries, or audits, and support resolution of any regulatory issues by preparing requested documentation and supporting senior colleagues.


Documentation & Submission Management

  • Assemble submission packages with precision—compiling documentation, certificates (e.G., GMP, certificates of analysis), product specifications, technical data, and translations where necessary.
  • Maintain regulatory dossier documentation in tracked systems to ensure completeness and ease of retrieval.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Coordinate with commercial, quality assurance, procurement, and legal teams to align on regulatory deliverables and prioritize registration activities.
  • Share documentation with regional/global RA teams for alignment.


Process Enhancement & SOP Development

  • Follow existing SOPs related to APIs/excipients registration, dossier submission, product renewal, and regulatory intelligence and provide feedback on potential improvements
  • Identify process inefficiencies and propose improvements to optimize submission workflows and compliance robustness.


Training & Regulatory Advocacy

  • Educate relevant internal teams (e.G. sales, imports) on regulatory implications—for example, registration deadlines, documentation requirements, handling of restricted substances—to ensure regulatory awareness throughout the organization.
  • When relevant, participate in trade associations or regulatory working groups to stay informed and potentially influence ANVISA’s regulatory environment.


Your profile

  • Education: Degree in Pharmacy, Chemistry, Life Sciences, or a related technical field.
  • Experience: 3-5 years of previous experience in Regulatory Affairs and Quality Assurance, preferably in the pharmaceutical sector.
  • Knowledge: Understanding of ANVISA regulations, GMP, and regulatory processes.
  • Skills: Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Communication: Ability to effectively interact with internal teams, customers, and suppliers.
  • Languages: Proficiency in English and Portuguese;
    Spanish is a plus.


What’s in for you?

  • Entrepreneurial position in a dynamic globally acting team
  • Your input is key and you’re part of creating our future success
  • Close cooperation with colleagues across the entire hierarchy within Selectchemie
  • Short decision processes
  • Attractive compensation package and hybrid working

title: Desenvolvimento De Negócios Globais - Especialistas Em Varejo
description:
Se você já liderou no varejo - na loja ou na sede - queremos falar com você.


Sim, somos uma empresa de tecnologia.


Não, você não precisa ter experiência em tecnologia.


Na STOREE.AI, criamos uma plataforma que permite que os gerentes se dupliquem em uma versão com inteligência artificial - um gêmeo digital capaz de liderar equipes, atribuir tarefas, acompanhar KPIs e treinar colaboradores.


Já somos utilizados por mais de 100 redes de lojas.


A tecnologia funciona.


Agora precisamos de pessoas que entendem de varejo para ajudar outros a entender como fazer isso funcionar para eles.


Por que a experiência em varejo é importante:


Nossa plataforma é ampla - ela pode fazer muita coisa.


Mas o que funciona bem para uma rede pode ser completamente diferente para outra.


Uma rede de cosméticos precisa de ferramentas diferentes das de um supermercado.


Um diretor de VM enxerga valor em funcionalidades diferentes das que importam para um head de RH ou de operações.


É por isso que não queremos vendedores.


Queremos profissionais de varejo que possam:


  • Entender as necessidades de uma rede
  • Guiá-los na criação do seu próprio gestor com IA
  • Ajudar nosso time interno a posicionar a solução certa para cada marca
  • Falar a linguagem do varejo, não jargões tecnológicos


Este é um desenvolvimento de negócios com profundidade - porque conhecer o varejo é o que faz tudo isso funcionar.


O que você vai realmente fazer:


  • Construir uma carteira de varejistas relevantes
  • Usar nossas ferramentas de IA (nós te ensinamos) para iniciar conversas
  • Explicar como a STOREE.AI resolve os desafios específicos de cada negócio
  • Guiar o processo ou repassá-lo para nosso time quando necessário
  • Ajudar a moldar o ajuste do produto internamente - você será nosso olhar de varejo


Você não vai fazer pitch.

Vai conectar, guiar e traduzir entre dois mundos.


Para quem é essa oportunidade:


  • Líderes distritais e regionais
  • Profissionais de sede nas áreas de operações, treinamento, RH, marketing ou excelência no varejo
  • Pessoas que lideraram operações de loja, VM ou experiência do cliente
  • Qualquer pessoa que entende como gerenciar lojas - e quer dar o próximo passo na carreira


Se você já disse: “A tecnologia não entende como é a realidade aqui na ponta” - nós concordamos.


É por isso que queremos você do nosso lado.


O que oferecemos:


  • Treinamento completo - não é necessária experiência em tecnologia
  • Trabalho remoto, com horários flexíveis
  • Comissões por resultados + possibilidade de efetivação em tempo integral
  • Trabalhar com uma empresa prestes a escalar globalmente
  • Fazer parte de algo real - nada de teoria


Isso não é um emprego. É a sua segunda carreira.

De especialista em varejo a líder em tecnologia.

De gerenciar equipes a liderar transformações.


Acesse nosso site:

title: Ngs Technical Sales Specialist | Genomics & Life Sciences (Brazil)
description:
About the Opportunity


Are you a scientist at heart, passionate about genomics and the power of technology to transform healthcare?

At MGI , we combine scientific excellence with innovation to redefine what’s possible in genetic sequencing and automation.

We’re seeking a NGS Technical Sales Specialist who blends a strong scientific foundation with a consultative commercial mindset — someone who can speak the language of researchers, understand their challenges, and guide them toward solutions that accelerate discovery.


What You’ll Do

Drive Scientific Engagement & Growth

  • Develop and execute a strategic sales plan for MGI’s sequencing and automation portfolio.
  • Identify, qualify, and close new business opportunities within universities, hospitals, research institutes, and biotech companies.
  • Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with key opinion leaders and research partners.


Act as a Scientific Partner

  • Provide consultative pre- and post-sales support to ensure customers achieve optimal experimental outcomes.
  • Collaborate with Field Application Scientists to deliver a seamless scientific and technical experience.
  • Conduct presentations, workshops, and seminars to demonstrate the impact of MGI technologies on research and clinical applications.


Market Intelligence & Collaboration

  • Stay ahead of market trends in genomics, molecular biology, and precision medicine to identify new growth opportunities.
  • Represent MGI at scientific conferences, trade shows, and regional events as a trusted partner in the life sciences community.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Management, Marketing, and R&D to align customer feedback with product innovation.


Reporting & Planning

  • Maintain accurate forecasts, pipeline data, and customer records using CRM tools (Salesforce).
  • Monitor performance metrics and adjust strategies to meet and exceed objectives.


Who You Are

  • A scientist with commercial curiosity — passionate about both research and relationship building.
  • Strong communicator who can translate complex scientific concepts into clear, compelling discussions.
  • Self-motivated, organized, and adaptable in a fast-paced environment.
  • Driven by the opportunity to make genomics more accessible and impactful for all.


What You Bring

Scientific Expertise

  • Solid understanding of genomics, molecular biology, or biotechnology .
  • Hands-on experience with NGS workflows, DNA/RNA sequencing, or lab automation .


Commercial Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in life science sales, business development, or field-based scientific roles .
  • Proven record of achieving or exceeding sales goals through consultative, science-driven engagement.


Education & Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences or a related field required;
    Master’s or Ph.D. preferred .
  • English: Advanced | Spanish: Intermediate to Advanced.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce and Microsoft Office Suite .
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% across Brazil.


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives.
  • Comprehensive health and dental insurance .
  • Meal stipend and fitness allowance to support wellbeing.


About MGI

MGI is a global leader in genomics innovation, delivering advanced sequencing and automation solutions that empower scientists and healthcare professionals worldwide.

Our mission is to make high-quality, affordable genomics accessible to all — enabling discoveries that improve lives and transform the future of medicine.

Join us and help shape the next generation of genomics.

title: Executive Administrative Assistant
description:
About the Role


This is not a typical virtual assistant position. We're looking for an AI-forward Executive Assistant with a Chief-of-Staff potential in the future who builds systems, owns outcomes, and drives the week to zero open tabs and inbox zero.

You'll work directly with Billie Graham , a strategic leader managing multiple high-growth ventures across commercial construction, lead generation, nonprofit leadership, property management, and family. Billie is based in Charlotte, NC, and needs someone who can anticipate needs, convert ambiguity into calendar blocks and checklists, and relentlessly close loops.

The Goal: Expand capacity and increase velocity of execution through systems, AI automation, and proactive operational support.

This role offers rare exposure to diverse industries while building the foundational processes that will enable rapid scaling. You'll be part of the early team, collaboratively identifying tools and systems needed to achieve great outcomes.

About Billie's Ventures


All ventures are in growth mode, and most do not have formal processes yet. You'll solve for and document processes to allow rapid onboarding of future hires with repeatable results.

  • Myers & Chapman – Strategic Markets Leader for Healthcare and Public Projects at this Commercial General Contractor
  • Leads Exchange Group – Industry networking agency launching a new high-ticket service offering in 2025
  • ReGroup Carolinas – Board Member for this nonprofit focused on workforce development in construction trades
  • Rental Property – Management of two rental units


Who We're Looking For


We need a systems-thinker with high agency who is AI-native, proactive, and relentlessly follows through. You should be comfortable with ambiguity, able to convert loose ideas into structured action plans, and driven to improve workflows weekly.

Critical mindset: We're looking for critical thinking over "task-taker." You should anticipate needs, propose solutions, and own outcomes—not just execute orders.

Personality Traits of Successful Candidates:
  • Proactive and calm under pressure
  • Highly organized and goal-oriented
  • Systems-first thinker with high agency
  • Pushes for clarity and closes loops consistently
  • Low-ego, coachable, rigorous about details and data
  • Comfortable saying "no/next" to protect priorities
Operational Cadence & Responsibilities
Weekly Rhythm:

Calendar & Commitments:

  • Own and manage family/school/kids' activities, professional meetings, travel, and reservations
  • Send Friday Weekly Brief : next week at a glance, risks flagged, top 3 priorities identified

Inbox & Communications:

  • Triage emails and meeting invites daily
  • File receipts and manage reimbursements
  • Maintain stakeholder communication loops

Task System:

  • Maintain running capture board across all ventures
  • Convert texts/voice notes → tasks with deadlines
  • Confirm task owner and status;
    nudge until done

Research & Automation:

  • Conduct project research and generate executive summaries
  • Web scraping and competitive tracking
  • Automate report generation and research tasks
  • Contact enrichment and CRM logging
  • Public records, permits, budgets research

SOP Engine:

  • Record Looms of recurring tasks
  • Ship 1+ SOP per week to the vault
  • Document processes to enable future team scaling
  • Iterate and refine edge cases

Family/Personal Operations:

  • Manage school communications and kids' calendars
  • Coordinate family travel and summer camp planning
  • Handle household-related administrative tasks

AI & Systems Improvement:

  • Propose workflow automation improvements weekly
  • Implement AI tools to increase efficiency
  • Build and optimize capture → triage → plan → execute systems
  • Raise quality bars continuously
Required Skills & Experience
Must-Have:


  • 1–2 years minimum executive assistant or operations experience
  • Advanced AI literacy : Fluent with ChatGPT, Copilot, and Perplexity;
    strong prompt crafting abilities
  • Calendar triage & stakeholder management : Expert-level scheduling and communication coordination
  • Research skills : Public records, permits, budgets, market intelligence
  • SOP creation : Ability to document processes via Loom-to-SOP workflow
  • Excel/Power BI basics : Structured data work and simple reporting
  • Clear written English : Concise, action-oriented communication style
  • Security hygiene : Understanding of role-based access and data protection
  • Documentation discipline : Rigorous attention to detail
  • Strong interest in AI use cases and implementation
Nice-to-Have:


  • Basic Python or no-code automation experience (Zapier, Make, n8n)
  • AEC (Architecture/Engineering/Construction) familiarity: Procore, RFQ/RFP exposure
  • Web scraping capabilities
  • HubSpot or CRM management experience
  • Contact enrichment skills (LinkedIn, research tools)
  • Power BI visualization and dashboard creation
  • Golf handicap lookup experience (when relevant for relationship building)
Tools & Platforms You'll Use


  • Email/SMS (Google & Microsoft suites)
  • Ninety.Io (project/goal management)
  • ChatGPT, Copilot, Perplexity (AI tools – critical)
  • Slack, Discord, Telegram (team communication)
  • SharePoint, Google Workspace, MS Teams (document management)
  • Excel (data organization)
  • Additional tools to be collaboratively identified
What We Offer


  • Compensation: Starting at $1,100 USD per month
  • Full-time position: 40 hours per week
  • Consistent schedule: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST, Monday–Friday
  • Fully remote: Work from anywhere
  • Direct collaboration with an entrepreneurial leader
  • Exposure to multiple industries: Construction, lead generation, nonprofit, real estate
  • Ground-floor opportunity: Help build foundational systems for scaling ventures
  • Learning environment: Strong focus on AI implementation and automation
Company Culture & Values


Culture in one line: We are problem solvers—systems over heroics—and the whole is greater than the sum of its parts.


Core Values:

  • Integrity
  • Growth Minded
  • In Service to Others
  • Provide Solutions
Onboarding & Support


There is currently no formal onboarding program—this will be part of the early partnership. You'll collaboratively identify the tools and support structures needed to achieve great outcomes. This is an opportunity to help shape the operational foundation from the ground up.


Application Process


Please send the following to (operations+ ) :

  1. Resume: As a PDF titled (Lastname.Firstname.ExecutiveAssistant.Pdf)
  2. Cover Letter addressing:
  • How you meet the required skills and experience
  • Specific examples of systems or SOPs you've built
  • Your experience with AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, Perplexity, automation tools)
  • A time you anticipated a leader's needs and proactively solved a problem
  • How you've closed loops and driven projects to completion
  • Why you're interested in supporting multiple ventures simultaneously
  1. AI Competency Example: Share a specific example of how you've used AI tools to automate a workflow, solve a problem, or improve efficiency
  2. Email Subject: Systems Over Heroics

Timeline: We aim to fill this position within 2–3 weeks.

Well-structured and thoughtful applications demonstrating critical thinking and systems-first approach will stand out. If you have questions about the role, feel free to include them in your message.

title: Structure Technician -
description:
Job Purpose

Responsible for performing structural maintenance, repair, and modification tasks on Emirates and third-party aircraft in accordance with approved company procedures, engineering documents, and regulatory requirements. The Structure Technician works as part of a team under the supervision and guidance of a Licensed Aircraft Engineer or Lead Technician.


About the Role

The Structure Technician will carry out inspections, repairs, fabrication, and installation of aircraft structural components and assemblies, ensuring airworthiness and quality standards are maintained at all times.


Responsibilities

  • Carry out structural maintenance, repair, and modification tasks on aircraft and components in accordance with approved manuals and procedures.

Qualifications & Experience

Required Skills

  • Proven experience in sheet metal and composite repairs.
  • Skilled in fabrication, riveting, and use of precision measuring tools.
  • Familiarity with aircraft safety and quality standards.
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings and technical documents.


Benefits

  • Tax-free salary: Monthly salary + overtime pay

  • Leave: 39 days annual leave + public holidays

title: Technical Solution Engineer - Sao Paulo
description:
About CATL

CATL invites you to continue our legend of green energy!

CATL is a World Fortune 300 Company, a global leader who provides premier EV battery and energy storage battery for the world. CATL's EV battery consumption volume has ranked No.1 in the world for seven consecutive years and global energy storage battery shipment has also ranked No.1 for three consecutive years.


Job Description


ESS Technical Solution Engineer is the combination of application engineer and sales engineer. A technical solution engineer should support and service the customer by demonstrating the product function, technical benefits and value to help customer meet their company and business goals and help company to win projects. Combining technical knowledge with strong communication and interpersonal skills, work closely with clients, understanding their specific needs, and then leverage their in-depth understanding of the company's products or services to provide tailored solutions that meet those needs effectively. Additionally, technical solution engineers should gather feedback from clients and bridge the gap between internal development team and customer requirements, helping to refine products and services based on customer needs and experiences.


Responsibilities:


  1. Product Demonstration: Deep understanding of the products or services of products and company. Be able to explain complex technical concepts to clients in a clear and understandable manner and contribute to sales presentations, as well as demonstrating products benefits, value and completed applications
  2. Client Engagement: Interact directly with clients to understand their needs, challenges, and requirements as well as the competition information from the competitors. Engage in discussions to gather information, analyze the client's projects and requirements, and identify opportunities where company's solutions can add value to win the opportunities
  3. Solution Development: Once understand the client's needs, sales engineers work to develop solutions that align with the client's projects. This may involve collaborating with the technical team to design tailored solutions that address specific challenges. Provide clients with technical support as needed and relay information to our development teams for product development and update needs
  4. Proposal Creation: Create detailed proposals that outline the proposed solution and its benefits. These proposals need to address the technical aspects while also highlighting the business value for the client as well as prepare the documents according to customer requirements which may include specifications, user’s manual, disposal proposal, etc.,
  5. Technical Support: Provide ongoing technical support to clients, answering questions, addressing concerns, and helping with any technical issues that arise
  6. Technical Agreement Negotiations: Involve in negotiations with clients, addressing any technical concerns, clarifying expectations, and ensuring that both parties are aligned on the proposed solution to form final technical agreement
  7. Risk Assessment and Problem Solving: Identify the possible issues ahead and provide preventative solutions for the risks. Resolve the technical issues during manufacturing, delivering and commissioning until successfully hand over to customer. Cooperate with internal development and project management team if needed
  8. Market Research: Stay informed about market trends, competitor offerings, and customer feedback. Generate ideas for product and service improvement and innovation based on market trends and customer inputs


Requirements and skills:


  1. At least 2 years work experience in local ESS market
  2. Previous work experience as an AE or SE of ESS market is advantageous
  3. Previous experience in utility or ESS developer company is advantageous
  4. Knowledge of local ESS projects development requirements is advantageous
  5. Exceptional customer service and interpersonal skills
  6. Excellent market and competitor analysis abilities
  7. Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities
  8. Superb collaboration and communication
  9. Superb logical and strategic thinking abilities
  10. Proficient in English & Portuguese

title: Merchant Onboarding Analyst (Shift Position)
description:
About us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arabic world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

Know more: Keeta website.


What you'll Do :

1. Review documents and information provided by merchants to ensure accuracy before the store goes live.

2. Upload and verify merchant account details, ensuring all information is complete, correct, and efficiently processed.

3. Check merchant qualifications according to company rules.

4. Review other applications submitted by business colleagues or merchants.

5. Organize and manage store photo-taking services.

6. Work according to a shift schedule (5x2), including night shifts and weekends.

7. Collaborate with Operations, Product, and other relevant teams to support merchant onboarding and resolve related issues.


What we need from You :

1. Responsible and reliable, willing to work hard to achieve team goals.

2. Eager to learn, open to new things, and able to adapt to changes.

3. Good communication skills, a team player, and willing to grow together with others.

4. Portuguese speaker, fluent in both spoken and written Portuguese. sales support is a plus (training will be provided).

5. Willing and able to work according to a shift schedule (5x2), including shift weekends. 6. Able to work efficiently under pressure, especially during peak periods, and handle handovers and transitions between teams smoothly.

7. Strong sense of responsibility and attention to detail in managing shift tasks and onboarding processes.


What makes this role excinting :

1.Take part in the rapid growth of Meituan's global delivery business, work with an international team, and enjoy plenty of opportunities to learn and grow.

2.Friendly and supportive team environment, where helps each other and grows together. Fun and relaxed atmosphere with everyone clear career development paths.


Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a clear vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 94 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora De Payments – Varejo
description:

das experiências marcantes dos serviços de beleza da Bluma e da nossa plataforma de educação financeira, a Emana Pay. Marcas e serviços relevantes para quem os utiliza e reconhecidos pelo nosso compromisso com a condução de negócios regenerativos.

Prazo indeterminado

  • Monitorar e atuar sobre KPIs de pagamento: TPV (Volume Total Processado), Taxa de Aprovação e NPS, promovendo melhorias contínuas;

Quais os requisitos?

O que você vai encontrar por aqui?

Somos mais do que um lugar de trabalho: construímos e vivemos diariamente o Ecossistema Bem Estar Bem, baseado na relação harmoniosa entre cada indivíduo, as relações ao seu redor e o ambiente em que está inserido. Além de oferecer benefícios voltados ao bem-estar social, físico, financeiro, mental e emocional, promovemos um ambiente de prosperidade, pertencimento e propósito, fortalecendo uma rede sólida de apoio, expansão de consciência e respeito à diversidade, equidade e inclusão.

Somos um movimento que transforma a maneira de viver e fazer negócios em 14 países da América Latina, sempre guiados por consciência.

A Natura celebra e abraça a diversidade em todas as suas formas e pluralidades.

Convidamos #Mulheres, #PessoasNegras, #PessoasComDeficiência, pessoas da comunidade #LGBTQIA+, #Gestantes e pessoas com #50anos+ a se candidatarem para esta vaga!

title: Trust Accountant Support Trainer
description:
Trust Accountant Support Trainer


Location: Brazil, fully remote

Type: Full-time, 8hours/day

Availability: ASAP to 2 weeks

Rate: 5,000 BRL to 14,000 BRL per month

Level: Junior to Senior

Setup: PJ/Consultancy

Industry: Hospitality/Accommodation/Rental

Experience:

  • Accounting or Bookkeeping (Required)
  • Onboarding Clients to understand Accounting

Equipment: Needs to have own machine, equipment not provided



Job Description

Do you have a strong accounting background but want more variety than balance sheets and reports? Do you enjoy teaching others, solving problems, and helping people succeed? If so, this role might be the perfect fit.

As a Software Accounting Trainer / Onboarding Specialist, you’ll play a key role in guiding new clients in the vacation rental industry through their onboarding process. You’ll ensure proper setup of taxes, fees, and trust accounting, and train clients on how to use the software system effectively to stay compliant and confident. This role blends accounting expertise with training, customer service, and problem-solving in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead onboarding and transition sessions for new vacation rental clients, ensuring accurate accounting system setup.
  • Train clients via Zoom on all accounting functions within the system, including trust accounting.
  • Perform and review accounting tasks such as:
  • Bank and non-bank account reconciliations
  • Entering transactions and journal entries
  • Preparing Trial Balance and Trust reports
  • Reviewing client entries for errors and developing correction plans
  • Identify misplaced or invalid data, troubleshoot issues, and ensure timely resolution.
  • Respond to support tickets and client calls promptly, providing clear, professional guidance.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships through exceptional customer service.
  • Write and update knowledge base articles to support client and internal education.
  • Lead webinars and group training sessions for clients and staff on accounting best practices.
  • Document and analyze client questions and escalate issues when necessary.
  • Collaborate with instructional design and internal teams to create and improve training resources.
  • Participate in team meetings and internal projects, contributing to process improvements and knowledge sharing.


Qualifications & Requirements

  • 2–5 years of accounting or bookkeeping experience, preferably in property management or vacation rental industries.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles;
    trust accounting knowledge highly preferred.
  • Experience with accounting for vacation rentals, property management, or hospitality a strong plus.
  • Proficiency with Excel, Word, and video conferencing tools (Zoom or equivalent).
  • Proven success in delivering excellent customer service.
  • Ability to communicate complex accounting concepts clearly to clients and colleagues.
  • Strong organizational skills, time management, and attention to detail.
  • Professional, polished, and engaging personality with an approachable teaching style.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment;
    quick learner and adaptable team player.


Why Join Us?

This role is ideal for accounting professionals who want to apply their technical expertise in a more dynamic, client-facing role. You’ll directly support vacation rental property managers by helping them master their accounting systems, stay in trust, and operate with confidence. At the same time, you’ll build skills in training, client success, and process improvement while working in one of the fastest-growing segments of the hospitality industry.

Are you an experienced fund professional ready to take the lead in managing complex fund structures, driving operational excellence, and fostering lasting client relationships? Join Amicorp Fund Services , a trusted global provider of fund administration and corporate services, and play a pivotal role in expanding our fund operations footprint.


About the Role

As Fund Operations Manager , you will ensure Amicorp meets all contractual, regulatory, and statutory obligations while actively supporting commercial growth. You’ll oversee the setup and administration of multiple investment funds, manage a dedicated team, and act as a key liaison between clients, investors, and internal departments.

This role blends technical fund expertise , leadership , and a commercial mindset — ideal for someone passionate about both operations and strategic growth.


Key Responsibilities

Client & Deal Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of fund administration clients, fostering long-term, trust-based relationships.
  • Advise on optimal fund structures, legal and regulatory frameworks, and ongoing process improvements.
  • Oversee the drafting and review of commercial, fiscal, and legal documentation.
  • Support fund launches, restructures, and liquidations, ensuring seamless execution and compliance.
  • Attend client and internal meetings to provide technical and operational insights.

Sales & Business Growth

  • Contribute to the commercial growth of Amicorp Fund Services by identifying opportunities and closing deals aligned with business targets.
  • Develop and execute an ambitious sales plan, focusing on expanding relationships with existing clients and attracting new investors.
  • Oversee smooth onboarding and transition management for new clients, ensuring a best-in-class experience.

Operational Excellence & Compliance

  • Collaborate with global accounting teams (India/Mauritius) to deliver accurate and timely fund administration services.
  • Review NAV packages, financial statements, and investor reports to ensure accuracy.
  • Monitor KYC/AML checks, fund compliance, and audit readiness.
  • Maintain comprehensive client records and ensure adherence to all reporting and regulatory requirements.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and mentor the Fund Operations team, ensuring high performance, accountability, and professional growth.
  • Oversee training, performance management, and productivity tracking.
  • Promote standardized procedures, process optimization, and continuous improvement across operations.


What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree (minimum) with 15+ years of experience in the investment fund industry.
  • Strong professional network within family offices, investment advisers, foreign investors, and the venture capital community.
  • Proven experience managing teams and fund operations in a fast-paced environment.
  • Expertise in fund accounting, NAV calculations, capital calls, audit processes, and tax fund structures.
  • Strong understanding of IFRS / US GAAP and both UCITS and Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) .
  • Excellent client-facing, communication, and leadership skills.
  • Commercially driven, proactive, and detail-oriented mindset.
  • Experience with PFX Paxus is an advantage.
  • CGA / CGE certification required.


Why Join Amicorp?

At Amicorp, we believe in empowering our people to lead with purpose, innovate fearlessly, and deliver excellence. You’ll work with a global network of experts, gain exposure to diverse jurisdictions, and be part of a company that values integrity, collaboration, and professional growth.

Join us to make a lasting impact in a dynamic and truly international fund services environment.

1 vaga para a escala de trabalho de Segunda a quinta-feira das 07h30 às 17h30 e Sexta-feira das 07h30 às 16h30

  • Cumprir normas de segurança do trabalho, meio ambiente e qualidade.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência comprovada em manutenção de sistemas automatizados industriais;

  • Boa comunicaçãoe trabalho em equipe;

Diferenciais: Noções de programação de CLPs, experiência em manutenção preditiva (vibração, termografia, etc.), NR-10 e NR-35 atualizados.

title: Learning Expert
description:
Job Summary : The Learning Expert is responsible for applying employee training programs, conducting training needs analysis, and developing engaging learning content. This role ensures smooth training logistics, maintains training records, and supports the continuous improvement of L&D initiatives.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Training Program Application

  • Schedule, organize, and deliver training programs through lectures, workshops, videos, e-learning, and blended formats.
  • Apply training logistics, including scheduling, venue bookings, facilitator coordination, and employee enrollment.
  • Maintain and update the Learning Management System (LMS) and training records.
  • Handle administrative duties such as tracking attendance, sending reminders, and managing training budgets.

2. New Employee Orientation Facilitation

  • Design, update, and facilitate engaging onboarding programs for new hires.
  • Collaborate with HR and department leaders to ensure a smooth transition for new employees.
  • Continuously improve trainings based on feedback and evolving company needs.

3. Training Needs Analysis & Evaluation

  • Conduct surveys, interviews, and performance assessments to identify skill gaps.
  • Monitor and evaluate training effectiveness through feedback, quizzes, and KPIs (e.G., completion rates, performance improvement).
  • Adjust training programs based on data insights to enhance engagement and knowledge retention.

4. Content & Training Material Development

  • Create and update training manuals, guides, job aids, and digital resources for employee learning.
  • Develop interactive content (e-learning modules, videos, quizzes, presentations).
  • Ensure materials comply with company policies and industry standards.

5. Training Delivery & Facilitation

  • Conduct engaging live and virtual training sessions for employees at all levels.
  • Use diverse training methods (role-playing, simulations, discussions) to maximize learning.
  • Provide post-training support to reinforce key concepts.

6. Stakeholder Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner with department heads to align training with business goals.
  • Support ad-hoc Learning initiatives (leadership development, new employees training, etc.).
  • Promote a culture of continuous learning through newsletters, LMS updates, and recognition programs.

7. Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in HR, Organizational Development, Education, or related field.
  • Experience: 7+ years in Learning, training application, or HR, including facilitation and content creation.
  • Language Proficiency: Fluent in English (written and spoken).
  • Technical Skills (Preferred/Nice-to-Have): Familiarity with LMS platforms and e-learning tools and knowledge of MS Office (PowerPoint, Excel) and video training software.
  • Soft Skills: Strong organizational and project management abilities, Engaging facilitator with excellent presentation and communication skills. Analytical mindset to assess training effectiveness and adapt programs.

title: Acquisition Editor, Life Science
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

We are seeking an ambitious individual to join our team as an Acquisition Editor. In this role, you will focus on recruiting new authors and content for our Journal.


Responsibilities:

  • Identify and recruit new authors, guiding them through the manuscript submission process for JoVE Journal.
  • Contact potential Guest Editors and collaborate with them to build a Methods Collections, our version of a special issue.
  • Establish and maintain a strong network of scientists/journal authors to drive content acquisition and grow submission rates.
  • Collaborate with the peer review team to facilitate the publication of manuscripts.
  • Meet or exceed monthly acquisition targets.


Requirements:

  • A Ph.D. in the Life Sciences.
  • Fluent English written and verbal communication skills.
  • Results-driven, with an ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational, influencing and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with the publishing process is a plus.


Why Join JoVE?

  • You can expect compensation competitively placed within the local market, including unlimited bonus for manuscript acquisition.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and discovery.
  • Opportunity to work in a remote environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

atuando na coordenação,acompanhamento e controle da equipe e dos programas financeiros;

  • Liderar e desenvolver a equipe de FP&A, promovendo alto desempenho e autonomia.


Requisitos :

  • Sólida experiência em FP&A, controladoria ou planejamento financeiro;
  • Experiência sólida em budget, forecast, valuation, report e KPIs financeiros;
  • Experiência em gestão de pessoas e desenvolvimento de equipe;
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma autônoma, com perfil “hands-on”;

Nossa cultura é movida por ownership, resultado e inovação. Acreditamos que cada epharmer é protagonista de sua jornada e peça fundamental no alcance de nossos objetivos estratégicos. Por isso, promovemos um ambiente onde o empoderamento, a colaboração e a busca constante por soluções inovadoras são os pilares do nosso crescimento. Somos uma organização dinâmica, que valoriza as conexões inteligentes e o impacto real que criamos na vida das pessoas.

Aqui, cada resultado é compartilhado e cada avanço é celebrado. Nossa missão é desafiar o status quo, oxigenar conexões e impulsionar a saúde em todas as dimensões. Com transparência e confiança, incentivamos cada colaborador a ir além, assumindo a responsabilidade por suas entregas e construindo, juntos, um legado de transformação.

title: Legal Senior Director
description:
Role Overview

We’re seeking a Legal Senior Director to lead and scale our legal function. This person will be responsible for designing, building, and leading the legal organization from “0 to 1” — putting in place frameworks, processes, policies, and a team that can support rapid growth, global operations, and cross‑functional strategy. You’ll be a generalist: you’ll advise on contracts, compliance, corporate governance, data privacy, consumer regulation, partnerships, commercial strategy, and more.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build and lead a legal team: hire, mentor, and manage internal lawyers and external resources.
  • Establish governance structures, policies, processes that enable scale (corporate structure, compliance framework, contract templates, approval workflows).
  • Oversee all aspects of regulatory and legal compliance: labor & employment, tax, consumer protection, data privacy (local and international), regulatory licensing, antitrust/competition, etc.
  • Draft, review, and negotiate complex commercial agreements: vendor/supplier agreements, partnerships, licensing, customer contracts.
  • Serve as trusted legal advisor to business leaders, helping evaluate risk while enabling speed.
  • Lead or support litigation or dispute resolution when necessary.
  • Monitor changes in laws/regulation;
    anticipate risk and proactively advise business on design of business models to mitigate legal/regulatory exposure.
  • Aid in market entry: setting up entities, corporate registrations, permits, relationships with regulators where needed.
  • Collaborate across international jurisdictions if applicable.


What We’re Looking For

  • LLB or equivalent;
    admitted to practice law.
  • Significant in‑house legal leadership experience (e.G. Director / Senior Counsel) ideally in tech, internet services, digital platform business, or fast‑growing scaleups.
  • Proven track record in taking legal functions from early stage (0→1) to scale: designing processes, building teams, putting in place governance.
  • Broad generalist knowledge: contracts, regulatory, compliance, consumer & data privacy, sourcing/licensing, etc.
  • Strong ability to make decisions under ambiguity, balancing risk and speed.
  • Excellent communication & negotiation skills (internal and external stakeholders).
  • Experience with competition law/antitrust cases, engaging with CADE.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese.
  • Experience working across multiple jurisdictions is a plus.


What You’ll Get

  • Opportunity to shape and build the legal function in a high‑impact, fast growth environment.
  • Collaborating closely with senior leadership and across all business units.
  • Competitive compensation + equity.
  • Flexible work environment;
    investment in professional development.
  • Exposure to global legal challenges, potentially multiple countries/regulations.

Metade da carga e do valor de uma rota cheia.

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, é uma multinacional americana com quase 30 anos de experiência por meio das companhias legadas DISYS e Signature Consultants. Presente no Brasil desde 2007, somos referência em soluções de staffing, TI e complementação de força de trabalho, atuando em diversos setores com alcance global e agilidade tática.


Sobre a Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior que será responsável por projetar, construir e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis em ambientes cloud, com foco em performance, governança e integração com múltiplas fontes de dados.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em AWS (S3, Glue, Lambda, IAM, Athena, Redshift ou equivalente)
  • Domínio de Databricks (Spark SQL, Delta Lake, clusters, jobs e notebooks)
  • Proficiência em Python para engenharia de dados (pyspark, pandas, boto3)
  • Forte conhecimento em SQL e modelagem de dados (dimensional, relacional e data lakehouse)
  • Experiência com pipelines ETL/ELT , versionamento com Git e práticas de CI/CD
  • Capacidade de analisar e otimizar performance de queries e jobs de processamento distribuído


Desejáveis

  • Vivência com arquitetura Lakehouse e Unity Catalog
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, Databricks Workflows, Step Functions )
  • Experiência com integrações via APIs REST e dados em tempo real (Kafka, Kinesis )
  • Familiaridade com boas práticas de FinOps e otimização de custos em ambientes cloud
  • Inglês desejável


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, notebooks e jobs)
  • Integrar e transformar dados de múltiplas fontes (bancos relacionais, APIs, S3, etc.)
  • Implementar boas práticas de versionamento, logging, monitoramento e documentação
  • Trabalhar em parceria com os times de Analytics, Data Science e Produto para garantir a qualidade e disponibilidade dos dados
  • Criar e otimizar consultas SQL e scripts em Python para grandes volumes de dados
  • Assegurar segurança e governança de dados , alinhado às políticas internas e à arquitetura AWS (IAM, Glue, Lake Formation, etc.)
  • Realizar tuning de performance em jobs Spark e consultas SQL

description:

title: Técnico De Qualidade Ii
description:
Buscamos profissionais que incorporem nossos valores, não têm medo de desafios, busquem inovar, experimentar e se aprimorar rapidamente. Nosso objetivo é contratar e reter os indivíduos mais brilhantes, oferecendo crescimento profissional e oportunidades de desenvolvimento em toda a carreira.


Se é você, adoraríamos conversar.


Sobre o papel

Estamos buscando um Técnico de Qualidade que contribuirá nas inspeções técnicas e de segurança para identificar e corrigir riscos e inconformidades.


Sobre o Grupo Bureau Veritas

Fundado em 1828, somos líder mundial em serviços de testes laboratoriais, inspeção e certificação, possuímos mais de 74 mil funcionários em 1.400 escritórios e laboratórios ao redor do globo. Nossa missão é oferecer serviços e soluções inovadoras para garantir que os ativos, produtos e processos de nossos mais de 400 mil clientes atendam a padrões e regulamentos em termos de qualidade, saúde, segurança, proteção ambiental e responsabilidade social. Há 190 anos nossa marca é sinônimo de integridade e confiança, em benefício dos negócios e das pessoas, contribuindo para transformar o mundo em que vivemos. Para saber um pouco mais acesse o site


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Monitorar e garantir o cumprimento de normas técnicas, de segurança e procedimentos operacionais.
  • Realizar inspeções técnicas e de segurança para identificar e corrigir riscos e inconformidades.
  • Elaborar relatórios e demais documentos técnicos da obra.


O que buscamos:

  • Ensino Técnico em Eletrotécnica ou Eletromecânica;
  • CNH categoria Bdefinitiva há pelo menos 1 ano e em situação regular;
  • Experiência em subestações de alta tensão;
  • Atuação em SPCS(sistemas de proteção, controle e supervisão);
  • Vivência em fiscalização de obras e operações em linhas de transmissão de alta e extra alta tensão;
  • Conhecimento das normas regulamentadoras aplicáveis;
  • Capacidade de identificar, avaliar e mitigar riscos de segurança;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhos noturnos, horários flexíveis e viagens, quando necessário;
  • Pacote Office em nível intermediário/avançado.


O que nós podemos oferecer:


Esta é uma ótima oportunidade para desenvolver sua carreira, trabalhando em uma equipe de especialistas. Nossos colaboradores são inovadores, curiosos e ambiciosos, sempre motivados e focados em novas soluções, pois, somos constantemente desafiados por uma indústria em rápida evolução que inclui um portfólio global de clientes, com milhares empresas, grandes e pequenas que confiam em nosso trabalho para melhorar seus negócios.

Ao participar deste processo de recrutamento & seleção, do Bureau Veritas Brasil, o(a) candidato(a) declara:


  • Estar em condições técnicas e operacionais, no que tange à ergonomia, estação de trabalho e velocidade de conexão internet para desempenhar, quando necessário, o trabalho remoto “home office”;
  • O Bureau Veritas está em conformidade com a Constituição Federal brasileira (no inc. V do seu art. 5o.Inc. XXVIII, a, do art. 5o) bem como, a Lei nº 13.709/18, que dispõe sobre o Tratamento e Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD). Sendo assim, mediante o seu consentimento com o envio de informações está em consonância com o Bureau Veritas, respeitando a Legislação supramencionada

title: Product Owner
description:
A RPE tem como objetivo viabilizar o amplo crescimento dos negócios varejistas e da economia nacional por meio de soluções ágeis, robustas, seguras e integradas a todo ecossistema de serviços financeiros.

Com mais de oitenta profissionais especialistas em tecnologia e meios de pagamento, atendemos mais de quarenta negócios varejistas, desenvolvendo soluções voltadas para a democratização do crédito nos pontos de vendas.

Se você está pronto para crescer e voar com a gente, esta é sua chance.

Estamos esperando por você!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar como ponto focal estratégico entre os canais demandantes e time de delivery.
  • Definir e priorizar o roadmap do produto, equilibrando iniciativas de negócio e evolução técnica.
  • Colaborar com os times técnicos em decisões sobre tecnologias, arquitetura, DevOps e escalabilidade.
  • Gerir o backlog do produto, traduzindo objetivos de negócio e requisitos técnicos em entregáveis claros.
  • Conduzir análises de mercado e benchmarks para identificar oportunidades de inovação e competitividade.
  • Representar o produto em reuniões estratégicas e negociações com clientes e parceiros.
  • Acompanhar métricas de performance do produto.
  • Análise financeira sobre seu Portfolio
  • Gestão de Roadmap trimestral de serviços e produtos internos e externos ( parceiros) avalia os resultados obtidos e faz ajustes na estratégia conforme necessário para garantir que o produto atenda às necessidades e expectativas dos stakeholders.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Forte orientação estratégica em negócios, com habilidade para alinhar objetivos organizacionais e evolução técnica do produto.
  • Desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicativos mobile.
  • Habilidade em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, Safe, etc..)
  • Vaga remota, eventualmente poderá ser convidado para alguma agenda presencial, previamente alinhada.
  • Necessário possuir habilidades de comunicação efetiva, pensamento estratégico, capacidade de tomar decisões, negociação e gerenciamento de expectativas.
  • Hábil na elaboração de apresentações executivas.
  • Métricas de produtos.
  • Participação ativa em squads ágeis, junto a times de tecnologia e design.
  • Elaboração de Business Plan e Business Case.


Informações adicionais

  • Modelo de trabalho híbrido em São Paulo (presencial 2x por semana no escritório).
  • Modelo de Contrato PJ



Conheça a RPE

Com mais de 20 anos de experiência e inovação, a RPE é uma empresa que transforma o varejo ao conectar tecnologia, expertise e resultados.

Somos a processadora de cartões, carnê e crédito digital líder do varejo nacional. Empoderamos varejistas na operação de crédito com autonomia, segurança e soluções end-to-end.

Liderada por especialistas consolidados no mercado, nosso ecossistema modular oferece soluções para toda a jornada digital da operação – desde a gestão integrada até a ampliação do acesso ao crédito, impulsionando o consumo, gerando resultados reais e transformando negócios.
